item.title: Bulletin updated at 12:42 HKT 31/Jan/2025
item.author: hkowm@hko.gov.hk (Hong Kong Observatory)
item.description:
General Situation:
The easterly airstream now affecting the coast of Guangdong will moderate in the next couple of days. The weather will be mild and relatively humid over the region. A cold front is expected to move across the coast of southern China on Monday. It will become cool with one or two rain patches over the region. The associated northeast monsoon will bring mainly fine and dry weather to Guangdong in the following couple of days. It will be cold in the morning over inland areas. With the monsoon being replaced by an easterly airstream gradually, it will be cloudier and windy over the coast of Guangdong in the middle and latter parts of next week.
